requests.response: Keep canonical data/context/capabilities and PII masking; closed case does not mean unreadable. Do not manufacture customer fields.

query.page: optional integer 1..100000; mutually exclusive with cursor

requests.response: data[] link rows; meta.total/per_page/page/hasMore/nextCursor/nextPage/pagination/consistency/snapshot; rows have component_issue_document_id, document_no, warranty_case_id, warehouse_id, status, version, posted_at, posted_time_status, created_at, can_open, detail_url. No lines in list.
data.document + sibling data.lines + data.history. Each lines[].items[] contains only POSTED selection evidence, not REMOVED. Immutable document ID is not a display number.

transport.mutation_headers: No Idempotency-Key or If-Match needed for these reads
transport.request_trace: meta.request_id is HTTP trace, never an operation receipt key
transport.cache: private, no-store; no cross-user/shared detail cache; Vary: X-Component-History-Contract

permissions.case: warranty.view OR warranty.manage, stable auth session, confirmed ACTIVE warehouse and persisted case ownership
permissions.links_and_mini_app_detail: (warranty.view OR warranty.manage) AND documents.read AND warranty.component_issue plus the same P09 session/warehouse/case/tenant protections
permissions.pii: warranty.pii.view controls document/line notes and actor identifiers; otherwise null with redaction flags. Case customer data remains the P09 canonical projection.
permissions.security_compatibility_change: Mini App detail now applies the P09 link ACL even without the new header. Stripping header is not a read-scope bypass. Canonical non-mini routes retain their existing owner policy. No permission or warehouse is inferred from role labels or a client case ID.
permissions.tenant: Reuse P09 isolate for document, line, item, SKU, movement, scan event and batch. Tenant columns without a trusted dimension fail closed. Existing schema with no tenant dimensions requires single-tenant database isolation.

sort_and_paging.p20: posted_at DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC; missing posted_at remains null, never created_at fallback
sort_and_paging.legacy_no_header: P09 link list remains created_at DESC,id DESC for compatibility. P20 must send the header.
sort_and_paging.cursor: P09 opaque encrypted cursor bound to path/case/query/actor/stable-session/warehouse/rights/tenant dimensions plus P20 contract/sort; 900 seconds fixed chain expiry. Never reuse legacy cursor in P20.
sort_and_paging.consistency: LIVE_READ_NOT_FROZEN_CROSS_REQUEST. Per-response snapshot is consistent; list/detail or multiple pages are not one frozen snapshot.
sort_and_paging.frontend: Hydrate by owner detail URL and immutable ID, verify returned case/kho/POSTED. Preserve link metadata separately; failed/403 detail is partial hydration not empty. Follow hasMore/nextCursor/nextPage, not rows.length; reject loops, deduplicate document IDs, discard stale-caller responses. Read retries repeat the same query/cursor. Expired cursor restarts from first page, not a new mutation.

scan_evidence.source: component_issue_items.scan_event_id -> scan_event -> scan_batch; batch must belong to this component document, warehouse and tenant. Event resolved target/type and VALID status must match persisted selected item/container.
scan_evidence.raw_code: Exact string stored in original scan_event; no trim/reformat, no current physical-code/SKU/item-ID fallback. This does not claim the upstream scanner preserved bytes it never stored. Missing source/identity returns null, not a fabricated code.
scan_evidence.removed: REMOVED rows excluded from history items and issued calculations; removed_item_count is diagnostic. scan_event_count/posted_item_count are counts of evidence, NOT issued quantity.
scan_evidence.unit: lines[].unit comes from current permitted sku.unit, labeled CURRENT_SKU_CATALOG, not a historical unit snapshot. Missing metadata stays null. Inactive SKU remains readable in historical evidence.

quantity.issued_qty: CONFIRMED only when negative COMPONENT_ISSUE movements with source_type COMPONENT_ISSUE_DOCUMENT and this document/line/kho/SKU match POSTED item quantities and scanned_qty. ITEM quantity must equal 1; BOX quantity uses stored selection, not box count. required_qty is display-only planned data, never fallback.
quantity.unknown: lines[].issued_qty and history.quantity_total are null on incomplete/mismatched evidence, not zero/planned or items.length.
quantity.total: history.quantity_total sums native line quantities, not distinct codes or rows. Do not treat a mixed-unit total as one physical unit; history.totals_by_unit is grouped from current catalog units. Missing unit is not invented.
quantity.read_effect: data.stock_effect describes historical document state; data.history.read_stock_effect=NONE. No read creates stock, scan events, business documents or request receipts.

errors.403: Missing exact permissions or existing warehouse data-scope guard; do not turn into empty
errors.404: Missing/out-of-scope case or document; do not use as mutation outcome
errors.422: Unknown filters/header, invalid query, WARRANTY_PAGING_CONFLICT, WARRANTY_CURSOR_INVALID or WARRANTY_CURSOR_SCOPE_MISMATCH
errors.503: COMPONENT_HISTORY_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE or WARRANTY_TENANCY_UNRESOLVED; not a zero total

dependencies: Navigate P09/P19/P21/P23 owners only. A new login may re-read authorized public business history after context confirmation but cannot reuse the old session cursor or take over a draft/operation receipt. P20 never reconciles/retries a mutation, Posts, cancels or switches context.

acceptance.ci: Isolated SQLite/PostgreSQL with synthetic records; owner P09/P19 regressions and route-cache rerun. Test code alone is not PASS evidence.
acceptance.live: Still required: release/build ancestry, schema/route guards, authenticated read/deny/cursor/partial-detail smoke with allowed account/case. No live create/seed/Post to manufacture history.
acceptance.ba: Confirm posted-at semantics and UI use of incomplete raw/quantity/unit metadata before production activation.
